# ”Räknar med en Fed-höjning i september”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-31  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon opens a new week with the OMX30 at a record high and up 15% so far this year. The mood is cautious because Kevin Warsh made hawkish comments, Bank of America and Barclays now expect a Fed rate hike in September, and US strikes on Iranian launchers pushed Brent to $90. The hosts cover AcadeMedia's year-end report, Mycronic's capital markets day, and a US federal court ruling that prediction markets are illegal gambling, which could lift sportsbook stocks such as Kambi. They also preview Clas Ohlson's and Sectra's reports, Friday's US jobs data and savers moving into defensive stocks and Klarna.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 MYCR — Mycronic | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Capital markets day today; financial targets may be raised. Up over 50% this year as an AI play.

#### Reasoning

Hosts note Mycronic already meets parts of its 2027-2030 targets, which date from about 2022, and has raised its revenue outlook. IR has said new targets could be possible. Strong momentum ('går som tåget') makes the CMD a near-term catalyst to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the CMD does not raise financial targets
- if the AI-related momentum fades

> *"Monica har totalavkastat över 50 % i år och går som tåget. Det har också blivit ett AI-derivat."*

---

### 🟠 KAMBI — Kambi | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

US federal court ruled prediction markets are illegal gambling; host expects Kambi could rise.

#### Reasoning

Prediction markets had taken share from sportsbooks. After the ruling, DraftKings and Flutter rose a few percent. The host thinks Kambi, as the most sportsbook-exposed name, could benefit. The ruling may be appealed to a higher court.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a higher court overturns the ruling

> *"Så jag tror att vi kan få se kanske lite uppställ i bl.a. Kambi."*

---

### 🟠 BETS-B — Betsson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

May benefit from the US ruling against prediction markets, but less than Kambi.

#### Reasoning

The host mentions Betsson in passing as a possible beneficiary of the ruling, with Kambi seen as the main one.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the ruling is overturned

> *"Kanske är vår Betsson, men framför allt Kambi"*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Reports Thursday together with August sales; has beaten expectations for years and the share has been very strong.

#### Reasoning

The host highlights a long run of reports that beat expectations and a very strong share price. The Thursday report and August sales figures are the near-term catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- if August sales disappoint
- if the report misses expectations

> *"Claes Ohlsson är alltid intressant. Det har varit helt otroligt att titta på de här rapporterna de senaste åren."*

---

### 🟠 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Solid report, but the dividend decision is postponed and the stock is weighed by political risk ahead of the election.

#### Reasoning

Adjusted EBITA rose 16% on 6% organic growth, in line with the July figures. Hosts link the dividend delay to the election in two weeks and note that political risk has hurt sentiment. The election outcome is the key swing factor.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the election brings a negative policy on independent schools
- if the dividend is cut

> *"Sentimentet kring Academedia har påverkats av en politisk risk."*

---

### ⛔ KLAR — Klarna | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Hosts are skeptical of the CEO buying more shares with the stock flat and call it tone-deaf.

#### Reasoning

Retail savers and the CEO are supporting the share price. Hosts call adding more Klarna shares while the stock is flat 'tondött' and doubt he knows something they do not. The skepticism is mild.

> *"Det känns lite tondött. Att utöka antalet Klarna-aktier ytterligare i flat."*

---
